content: The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on **August 11, 1999**. This was a total solar eclipse that was visible across much of Europe, the Middle East, and parts of Asia. It was particularly notable as it was one of the most viewed eclipses in human history, with its path of totality crossing through densely populated areas of Europe including parts of the UK, France, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania.
